description:
The Solutions Engineering Analyst sits at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and client success. You'll have the opportunity to work on complex, high-impact initiatives, collaborate with teams around the world, and help create solutions that drive growth for our clients and Assurant alike.
 
 ** This is a hybrid role and will be required to be in the Miami office 3 days per week *** 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Help design and develop customized solutions that meet the unique needs of current and prospective clients.
 Partner with the Director of Solutions Engineering to create technical blueprints and solution strategies that serve as the foundation for client implementations.
 Support the sales process by contributing to RFP responses, proposals, and solution presentations.
 Collaborate with Account Executives, Project Managers, and Implementation Managers to understand business requirements and translate them into actionable solutions.
 Provide subject matter expertise throughout the sales and implementation lifecycle to ensure successful outcomes.
 Work closely with Product Development, Compliance, and other cross-functional teams to ensure solutions align with regulatory requirements and company policies.
 Build a strong understanding of Assurant's products, platforms, capabilities, and services, using that knowledge to recommend the best solutions for client needs.
 Foster strong partnerships across the organization, balancing priorities and aligning stakeholders around shared business goals.
 Collaborate with global teams on international opportunities, helping drive consistency, knowledge sharing, and successful solution delivery worldwide.
 Support the communication and rollout of new client implementations, product launches, and service enhancements.
 Contribute to strategic initiatives, committees, and special projects that support business growth and innovation.
 Help connect people, processes, and technology to deliver solutions that create value for both clients and the business.
 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical degree.
 2+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: client management, project management, business analysis, data analytics, product development, management information systems, or sales support.
 2+ years of experience working with technical platforms, system integrations, or interoperable technologies. Experience with Assurant systems is a plus.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect business needs to practical solutions.
 Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with a talent for collaborating across teams and functions.
 Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 Curious, proactive, and eager to learn new technologies, products, and business processes.
 
 Why Assurant?   
 People First – we prioritize employee well-being and development  
 Empowerment – we enable our people to do their best work  
 Benefits effective day one  
 401K Match – up to 6% dollar-for-dollar  
 
 The Company  
 Assurant, Inc. redefines the boundaries of protection — safeguarding and servicing connected devices, homes, automobiles, and commercial equipment in partnership with the world’s most successful brands. As a Fortune 500 company operating in 21 countries, Assurant leads the way in leveraging insights and technology to transform customer connections that build loyalty and drive value. With more than 325 million consumers protected worldwide, Assurant is behind the scenes helping brands deliver reliable, meaningful experiences customers can count on, so brands can shine and customers can have peace of mind.  
   
 Global Impact  
 Assurant is a purpose-driven company committed to advancing a connected, respected, and protected world. Through our focus on  Connected Communities ,  Respected Resources , and a  Protected Planet , we integrate sustainability into our long-term strategy in ways that support our business, strengthen operations, and help us deliver value for clients, customers, employees, and communities.  
   
 Assurant Culture  
 The Assurant Way defines how we show up for our clients, customers, communities, and one another — with Common Sense, Common Decency, Uncommon Thinking, and Uncommon Results. Recognized on Forbes’ list of the  World’s Best Employers , named among Fortune’s  America’s Most Innovative Companies , and consistently ranked as a “Best/Great Place to Work” in 14 countries, Assurant attracts talented people who are passionate about service, practical innovation, and delivering meaningful results.  
   
 Benefits & Rewards  
 Assurant is committed to providing a competitive rewards package that offers market-competitive benefits and resources designed to support physical, emotional, financial, and social wellbeing.  
 
 #LI-Remote 
 #AssurantProudKS 
 
 
 
 Pay Range:
$74,600.00 - $124,700.00
 Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

 If there is no posting end date listed then this is a pipeline requisition, and we will continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis.
 
 

 Helping People Thrive in a Connected World 
Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at  jobs.assurant.com .

 For U.S. benefit information, visit  myassurantbenefits.com . For benefit information outside the U.S., please speak with your recruiter.

 What’s the culture like at Assurant? 
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture  The Assurant Way .

 Company Overview 
Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

 AI and Biometric Usage 
 Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.
  
 Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

 Equal Opportunity Statement 
Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

 Job Scam Alert 
Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here .
